note: Lunar and movable dates for 2026-2028, checked 2026-11-04. 'sources' says what each year rests on. A date not listed here is never guessed: that node stays off for that year (the January refresh or %APPDATA%\TVMode\occasions.json can fill it). Edit a copy in %APPDATA%\TVMode\occasions.json to override.

sources.2026: drikpanchang.com Indian calendar 2026 (New Delhi) for every date; Government of India DoPT 2026 holiday list (via offrd.co copy) agrees on Holi 4 Mar, Dussehra 20 Oct, Janmashtami 4 Sep, Diwali 8 Nov, Guru Nanak Jayanti 24 Nov; Eid al-Adha 28 May per the DoPT memorandum of 22 May 2026 reported by staffnews.in (the list first said 27 May); Dhanteras 6 Nov and Anant Chaturdashi per dekhopanchang.com. Eid al-Fitr: drikpanchang 20 Mar, DoPT list 21 Mar (moon sighting), unresolved, window absorbs it.
sources.2027: drikpanchang.com Indian calendar 2027 and its Navratri page. DoPT 2027 list not published at check time. Eid dates are astronomical (moon sighting in India may move them a day). Single source.
sources.2028: drikpanchang.com Indian calendar 2028 and its Navratri page. DoPT 2028 list not published at check time. Eid dates are astronomical. Single source.
sources.events: Oscars 2027 and 2028 announced by the Academy (April 2026), subject to change; ICC Men's ODI World Cup 2027 per icc-cricket.com (2 Oct to 21 Nov); IPL 2026 and ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 played (28 Mar to 31 May; 7 Feb to 8 Mar). IPL 2027 and 2028 are NOT announced: left off.
sources.2015-2025: Past Diwali, Eid al-Fitr and Holi dates are from the spec's seed list, not re-checked against a source. They only set a coarse release-date window for the film-release signal.
